law.citation: Songwe Region was formed in 2016 from the western districts of Mbeya Region. ISO 3166-2:TZ lists it as TZ-31.

units.citation: Wikidata, the item whose ISO 3166-2 code (P300) is this unit's: English label, item id and code. The GeoNames id is the unit's row in GeoNames admin1CodesASCII.txt.

membership.citation: Each member is assigned to the region that GeoNames files most of the populated places inside its boundary under, counted on 2026-11-26.

units.name: Mbeya
units.note: The Chunya record's boundary predates the creation of Songwe District from part of it: GeoNames files 61% of the populated places inside it under Mbeya Region and the rest under Songwe Region.
